name: Search API Stats Term Blocks
description: Display Drupal blocks for top search terms.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 Enabling the recording and presentation of statistics for the Search API module. There are plans to implement usage and performance statistics in the near future. For now this module gives your Drupal site a top search phrases block for all the Search API indices on your site.

 Back to top 

 Instructions 
 
 Have some Search API indices already made. 
 Enable the search_api_stats module. 
 Enable the search_api_stats_block module. 
 Place the block for the index you want to show top search phrases for like you would. (ie. Block config, context, panels etc). 
 Configure the block and set the search page's path and the keywords parameter name. 
 Done!
